for k, v in pairs(data) do
	if v.branches then
		for _, branch in ipairs(v.branches) do
			data[branch].parent = k
		end
	end
end

for _, m in ipairs({
	require('Module:Character/operator6'),
	require('Module:Character/operator5'),
	require('Module:Character/operator4'),
	-- require('Module:Character/operator3'),
	-- require('Module:Character/operator2'),
	-- require('Module:Character/operator1'),
}) do
	for k, v in pairs(m) do
		local faction = v.faction
		data[faction] = data[faction] or {}
		data[faction].operators = data[faction].operators or {}
		data[faction].operators[k] = v
	end
end

return data
